content: Dawud inna: “Ma iqqim ɛad ca n yijjen zi taddart n Cawul, ḥima necc ad as ssecneɣ tamexsiwt inu icewwaren di ṭṭweɛ n Yunatan?”
Tuɣa din ijj n umsexxar ɣar taddart n Cawul, ttřaɣan as Ṣiba. Řaɣan as-dd ɣar Dawud. Inna as ujeǧid: “Ma cek d Ṣiba?” Netta inna: “D amsexxar nnec.”

Ajeǧid inna: “Ma iqqim ɛad ca n ijj zi taddart n Cawul iddar, ḥima ad as ssecneɣ tamexsiwt icewwaren n AREBBI?” Xenni inna Ṣiba i ujeǧid: “Aqa din ɛad ijj n mmis n Yunatan wenni d aneɛḍab zi tnayen n iḍaren.”
Inna as ujeǧid: “Mani iǧa netta?” Ṣiba inna as i ujeǧid: “Xzar, netta aqa-t di taddart n Maxir, mmis n Ɛammiyil, di Lu-Dabar.”
Xenni issekk ujeǧid Dawud din u yiwyi t-i-dd zi taddart n Maxir, mmis n Ɛammiyil di Lu-Dabar.
Umi Mafibucat, mmis n Yunatan, mmis n Cawul, yudef ɣar Dawud, iwḍa s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt, yuḍar as. Dawud inna: “Mafibucat!” Netta inna: “Xzar, aqa da amsexxar nnec.”
Dawud inna as: “War tteggʷed, maɣar necc ad ac ssecneɣ tamexsiwt inu icewwaren di ṭṭweɛ n babac Yunatan. Necc ad ac arreɣ marra iyyaren n jedd nnec Cawul u cek ad tecced řebda macca ɣar ṭṭabřa inu.”
Xenni yuḍar as, inna: “Min iɛna umsexxar nnec ařami cek texzared ɣar ijj n weqzin immuten am mammec ǧiɣ necc?”
Xenni iřaɣa ujeǧid x Ṣiba, amsexxar n Cawul, inna as: “Marra min iǧan n Cawul d marra taddart nnes, wciɣ t i mmis n sidi nnec.

Cek ad as tcarzed tammurt, cek d iḥenjiren nnec d imsexxaren nnec, uca ad as tawyed ṣṣabet nnes, ḥima mmis n sidi nnec ad ɣares yiři weɣrum maḥend ad yecc. Mafibucat, mmis n sidi nnec, ad yecc řebda aɣrum ɣar ṭṭabřa inu.” Ṣiba tuɣa ɣares xemmesṭac n iḥenjiren d ɛicrin n imsexxaren.
Ṣiba inna i ujeǧid: “Amsexxar nnec ad igg ɛlaḥsab marra min yumur sidi inu ajeǧid i umsexxar nnes!” Dawud inna ɛad: “Mafibucat ad icc ɣar ṭṭabřa inu am yijjen zeg iḥenjiren n ujeǧid.”
Mafibucat tuɣa ɣares ijj n mmis ttřaɣan as Mixa. Marra inni tuɣa izeddɣen di taddart n Ṣiba tuɣa aten d imsexxaren n Mafibucat.
U Mafibucat tuɣa izeddeɣ di Urcalim, maɣar netta ittett řebda ɣar ṭṭabřa n ujeǧid. Netta tuɣa-t d aneɛḍab zi tnayen n iḍaren.
